title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hooks and quality gating
author: Jordan Lee
description:
Background: Our eval harness runs end-to-end prompt sets during nightly CI but does not enforce per-prompt regressions on PRs. This PR introduces a GitHub Actions CI hook that runs a lightweight per-prompt regression check on changed prompts and model-facing code, failing the check when a prompt's metric crosses a configured delta threshold. Motivation: catch regressions earlier, reduce noisy post-merge rollbacks, and tie alerts to specific prompt examples.

What this PR does: Adds a new eval-harness CLI subcommand (ci-check) and a GitHub Actions workflow (eval-per-prompt-ci.yml) that: 1) detects changed prompt sets and relevant model-serving code in the PR; 2) runs a focused eval on only the impacted prompts using a pinned model bundle; 3) computes pre-configured metrics (accuracy, consistency score, hallucination rate, embedding-similarity) per prompt; 4) compares metrics to baseline values stored in eval-harness/baselines/{suite}.json and fails the job if deltas exceed the thresholds defined in eval-harness/config/ci_thresholds.yaml. Also: - Implements retry/backoff for transient infra flakiness. - Emits structured JSON artifacts for the Console to ingest (per-prompt diffs and aggregated regression summary). - Adds a lightweight gating mode (warn-only) that can be toggled via repo label.

Key design notes: - Per-prompt baselines are small JSON files (human-reviewed) to limit noise. - Thresholds are conservative by default and can be tightened incrementally under ENG-2201. - Workflow runs use a small pinned GPU runner (or CPU fallback) to keep latency under 10 minutes for typical PRs. - The check is gated behind the label "eval/strict-gate" for unstable suites.

Testing and rollout: Unit tests added for the CLI parsing and threshold comparisons. Integration tests added to the eval-harness test matrix; CI workflow was smoke-tested on the redwood repo using a branch deployment. Rollout plan: enable warn-only by default, flip to fail for the top-3 prompt suites after one week of telemetry.

Related: Linear ENG-2143 (per-prompt CI hooks), ENG-2201 (threshold tuning).

+    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04

release_notes:
- Adds per-prompt regression CI hook (GitHub Actions) and a ci-check CLI for targeted evals.
- Baseline storage and threshold config for per-prompt gating.
- Warn-only rollout and sampling heuristics to limit PR latency.
notes_for_ops: Console ingest connector updated to accept eval-harness JSON artifacts. Ops: ensure the eval-artifact S3 bucket has write permissions for GH Actions runners. See docs/eval/ci-hooks.md for config.
observability_changes: Adds metrics: eval_ci.run_duration_seconds, eval_ci.prompt_regressions_total (labels: suite, prompt_id, severity), eval_ci.artifact_upload_success
